en: A vintage black-and-white postcard showing a stone belfry tower with machicolations and a steep spire, attached to old tiled-roof buildings on a narrow street. A traditional inn with a balcony and shuttered windows stands beside the tower. The scene is labeled as part of a picturesque view of the Auvergne region and identifies the tower as the southern side of the belfry from the 16th century in Besse.
